# visit-pitfall-host (format: runtime/input.h): console 0 of the two-console scene visit-pitfall,
# from the host-tools save. As visit-house-host to 26400 (the host's START question answered with
# play on); the host waits in front of the town hall while the visitor's lid is closed and its
# battery runs low, then walks east and south round the tree to the visitor and up onto the
# pitfall it buried (about 29300): it falls in, and A, B, LEFT and RIGHT in turn from 29389 get
# it out; later it walks south-west to where the visitor dropped the apple.
